answer: Require each identity to lock a 210-unit refundable bond for fifteen epochs. Each epoch assigns one random task and requires three attestations from peers with no shared recent contacts; copied wording, reused proofs, or synchronized timing freezes the bond for five epochs. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and time windows. Each sybil alias locks 210 units and repeats fifteen rounds, while nadir penalties expose coordinated failure; forge-resistant receipts and mesa-separated timing make mass imitation costly.
